sentence: This project tries to find out the molecular mechanisms behind Ewing sarcoma, a bone tumor of children and adolescents.
This project builds a method that maps genes and proteins in tumor tissue in 3D to study how cancer cells interact with their surroundings.
This project builds computer models that study how biomolecular condensates form and why faulty ones are linked to diseases.
This project tries to find the molecular and genomic drivers of how well immunotherapy works in cancer patients.
This project studies how super-enhancers of Epstein-Barr Virus switch on oncogenic drivers that turn normal B lymphocytes into lymphoblasts.
This project studies how mutations in the mitochondrial genome build up with tissue aging and whether they harm progenitor cells.
This project builds a glass-based material for radiographic imaging devices to detect high energy x-rays more efficiently.
This project studies how the RNA exosome helps human motor neurons develop, using motor neurons that carry disease-causing mutations.
This project tries to grow human skin in the lab that matches skin from body regions such as the scalp, face, and feet.
This project studies how mutations that copy pieces of DNA and move them around the genome create genes that help animals adapt or cause disease.
This project tries to find out what controls the structure, turnover, and safeguarding of mitochondria.
This project builds software to support cancer research on pediatric solid tumors, lung cancer, and sarcoma.
This project tries to find a region of the noncoding genome that controls a receptor made in the liver, linked to heart attack and stroke.
This project studies how spermatogonial stem cells are maintained through adulthood to keep up sperm production in males.
This project uses brain imaging to find measurable biomarkers that predict outcomes in children and adolescents with concussion.
This project uses drug screening to look for antivirals that target Mpox virus.
This project tests axon fusion and localized immunosuppression of peripheral nerve allografts as treatment for segmental-loss nerve injuries.
This project studies how malaria transmission differs between urban and rural areas and how it relates to mosquito ecology.
